reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per lead
  SELECT email, source, created_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY email ORDER BY created_at, lead_id) AS rn
  FROM leads
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at) AS first_month,
       COUNT(*) AS new_contacts,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source IN ('display', 'events', 'paid_search', 'paid_social', 'review_sites')) AS paid_contacts
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', created_at)
alternatives:
WITH firsts AS (  -- one row per email
  SELECT email, MIN(created_at) AS created_at
  FROM leads
  GROUP BY email
),
first_ids AS (  -- one row per email
  SELECT l.email, MIN(l.lead_id) AS lead_id
  FROM leads l
  JOIN firsts f ON f.email = l.email AND f.created_at = l.created_at
  GROUP BY l.email
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', l.created_at) AS first_month,
       COUNT(*) AS new_contacts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.source IN ('display', 'events', 'paid_search', 'paid_social', 'review_sites') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_contacts
FROM first_ids fi
JOIN leads l ON l.lead_id = fi.lead_id
WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', l.created_at)

SELECT date_trunc('month', t.created_at) AS first_month,
       COUNT(*) AS new_contacts,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.source IN ('display', 'events', 'paid_search', 'paid_social', 'review_sites')) AS paid_contacts
FROM (
  -- one row per lead, numbered within its email from the earliest
  SELECT email, source, created_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY email ORDER BY created_at, lead_id) AS rn
  FROM leads
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1 AND t.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', t.created_at)

other_way.sql:
WITH firsts AS (  -- one row per email
  SELECT email, MIN(created_at) AS created_at
  FROM leads
  GROUP BY email
),
first_ids AS (  -- one row per email
  SELECT l.email, MIN(l.lead_id) AS lead_id
  FROM leads l
  JOIN firsts f ON f.email = l.email AND f.created_at = l.created_at
  GROUP BY l.email
)
SELECT date_trunc('month', l.created_at) AS first_month,
       COUNT(*) AS new_contacts,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.source IN ('display', 'events', 'paid_search', 'paid_social', 'review_sites') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_contacts
FROM first_ids fi
JOIN leads l ON l.lead_id = fi.lead_id
WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', l.created_at)
other_way.tradeoff: The earliest time per email, then the lowest lead_id at it, avoids the window; a CASE sum stands in for FILTER on engines without it.

solver.query:
WITH r AS (SELECT source, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY email ORDER BY created_at, lead_id) AS rn FROM leads)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS first_month, COUNT(*) AS new_contacts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source IN ('display','events','paid_search','paid_social','review_sites')) AS paid_contacts
FROM r WHERE rn = 1 AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1
